name: human_methylation_bench_ver1_train
description:
Human DNA Methylation Dataset ver1
	

This dataset is a benchmark dataset for predicting the aging clock, curated from publicly available DNA methylation data. The original benchmark dataset was published by Dmitrii Kriukov et al. (2024) by integrating data from 65 individual studies.
To improve usability, we ensured unique sample IDs (excluding duplicate data, GSE118468 and GSE118469) and randomly split the data into training and testing subsets (train : test = 7 : 3) to facilitate… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openaging/human_methylation_bench_ver1_train.
evaluation_method: MAE (mean absolute error), RMSE, Pearson correlation
reputation: Curated from 65 public studies for epigenetic aging-clock research; used by researchers in computational aging and epigenetics.
